visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in a black Nike sweatshirt standing in a bright, modern white kitchen. He holds two halves of a sandwich filled with a chunky yellow mixture toward the camera. He transitions to holding a small glass bottle with a black label, tossing it playfully. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clean white cabinets and a stainless steel range hood in the background. (2) The man begins the cooking process by showing a packaged block of tofu and then crushing it manually into a large glass bowl with his hands. He moves to a wooden cutting board where he slices a large orange pumpkin wedge into smaller cubes. These cubes are then shown being steamed in a pot and subsequently mashed into a thick, smooth paste using a silver fork in a white bowl. (3) The scene shifts to a stove where the man stir-fries the tofu crumbles in a black pan until they appear slightly golden and firm. He adds the pumpkin mash, stirring until the mixture takes on a vibrant yellow color. He then prepares a white dressing by blending liquid ingredients in a tall beaker with a hand blender, adding a pinch of black salt from the small bottle. (4) In the final phase, he combines the dressing with the tofu-pumpkin mix, seasons it with black pepper, and spreads it thick on white bread. A woman wearing glasses and a beige shirt joins him. They both take large bites of the sandwiches, exhibiting high-energy facial expressions and enthusiastic gestures while talking and reacting to the taste in the kitchen.

The background music remains constant, providing a steady rhythmic foundation beneath these incidental kitchen noises. The male voice continues narration with high arousal. Metallic scraping sounds of a spoon against a glass bowl are clearly audible during the mixing process. (4) The final section features high-arousal vocalizations from both a male and a female voice, including cheers, exaggerated 'mm' chewing sounds, and shared laughter. The music swells slightly, and various cartoonish sound effects like pops and bubbles are used to accent the quick editing cuts and the characters' energetic reactions.
